objective: Measure end-to-end toy ECDLP relation collection through independently verified logarithm extraction.
status: frozen replication protocol; completion does not by itself satisfy the persistent breakthrough gate
arms: standard polynomial factor space with exact prime-subgroup membership clauses
fixed trace-one affine control with exact membership clauses
sparse density-selected affine base with exact membership clauses and schedule [0,0,0]
same sparse base with exact membership clauses and Frobenius schedule [0,1,2]
shared_target_rule: For each seed generate uniform nonzero a*P+b*Q targets; interleave active arms in a seeded randomized order.
stopping_rule: Stop an arm only after a relation dependency recovers the simulation secret and d*P=Q, or after all 192 targets. Other arms continue independently.
rank_rule: Insert only point-certified relations. Reduce factor columns over the prime subgroup order. Frobenius-image points rewrite through signed powers of the verified eigenvalue. Verify the rewritten point equality before insertion.
cost_accounting: Record all encoding and solving wall time, timeouts, relation count, rank, first extraction, factor-base columns and prior selection cost. Timeout is operational censoring.
controls: Known secret is used only to create Q and verify extraction. It is not supplied to factor selection, SAT, relation coefficients or elimination.
success: A faster verified extraction replicated across later target streams can support an implementation breakthrough claim only after independent adversarial review and a literature/scale boundary.
falsifier: Sparse or Frobenius arms fail to extract, lose after rank/cardinality accounting, or checks disagree.
